Every refresh must invoke its supplied fetch(key), even while another
refresh is pending. No duplicate suppression, serialization or automatic cancellation.
Each call returns its own exact fetched object or propagates its own exception.
Only the latest-started refresh owns pending and may publish value. Earlier success,
failure or cancellation cannot clear pending while the latest is unresolved.
Latest settlement clears pending even if older calls remain running. Keep the prior
value during loading and on failure/cancellation. Instances are independent.
Synchronous fetch failure also clears its owning pending state. Retry is allowed.

        self.generation += 1
        generation = self.generation
        self.pending = True
        try:
            value = await fetch(key)
            if generation == self.generation:

            return value

+import asyncio
+import unittest
+
+from preview import Preview
+
+
+TIMEOUT = 2
+
+
+class ControlledFetch:
+    """Record invocation immediately; let the test settle the returned future."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = asyncio.Queue()
+
+    def __call__(self, key):
+        result = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
+        self.calls.put_nowait((key, result))
+        return result
+
+
+class PreviewTests(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
+    async def asyncSetUp(self):
+        self.tasks = []
+
+    async def asyncTearDown(self):
+        for task in self.tasks:
+            if not task.done():
+                task.cancel()
+        if self.tasks:
+            await asyncio.wait_for(
+                asyncio.gather(*self.tasks, return_exceptions=True), TIMEOUT
+            )
+
+    async def start(self, preview, key, fetch=None):
+        if fetch is None:
+            fetch = ControlledFetch()
+        task = asyncio.create_task(preview.refresh(key, fetch))
+        self.tasks.append(task)
+        actual_key, result = await asyncio.wait_for(fetch.calls.get(), TIMEOUT)
+        self.assertIs(actual_key, key)
+        return task, result
+
+    async def outcome(self, task):
+        return await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(task), TIMEOUT)
+
+    async def succeed(self, task, future, value):
+        future.set_result(value)
+        self.assertIs(await self.outcome(task), value)
+
+    async def reject(self, task, future, cancellation):
+        if cancellation:
+            task.cancel()
+            with self.assertRaises(asyncio.CancelledError):
+                await self.outcome(task)
+            self.assertTrue(task.cancelled())
+        else:
+            error = RuntimeError("controlled failure")
+            future.set_exception(error)
+            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught:
+                await self.outcome(task)
+            self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)
+
+    async def seeded(self):
+        preview = Preview()
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIsNone(preview.value)
+        value = object()
+        task, future = await self.start(preview, object())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIsNone(preview.value)
+        await self.succeed(task, future, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+        return preview, value
+
+    async def pair(self, preview, prior):
+        # The same key and callback must still produce two overlapping calls.
+        key, fetch = object(), ControlledFetch()
+        older = await self.start(preview, key, fetch)
+        latest = await self.start(preview, key, fetch)
+        self.assertFalse(older[0].done())
+        self.assertFalse(latest[0].done())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        return older, latest
+
+    async def test_older_success_before_latest_success(self):
+        preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+        older, latest = await self.pair(preview, prior)
+        await self.succeed(*older, object())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(latest[0].done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*latest, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+
+    async def test_latest_success_before_older_success(self):
+        preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+        older, latest = await self.pair(preview, prior)
+        value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*latest, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(older[0].done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+        await self.succeed(*older, object())
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+
+    async def earlier_rejection(self, cancellation):
+        preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+        older, latest = await self.pair(preview, prior)
+        await self.reject(*older, cancellation)
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(latest[0].done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*latest, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+
+    async def test_earlier_failure_keeps_latest_pending(self):
+        await self.earlier_rejection(False)
+
+    async def test_earlier_cancellation_keeps_latest_pending(self):
+        await self.earlier_rejection(True)
+
+    async def latest_rejection_and_retry(self, cancellation):
+        preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+        older, latest = await self.pair(preview, prior)
+        await self.reject(*latest, cancellation)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(older[0].done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        retry = await self.start(preview, object())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        await self.succeed(*older, object())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(retry[0].done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*retry, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+
+    async def test_latest_failure_and_retry(self):
+        await self.latest_rejection_and_retry(False)
+
+    async def test_latest_cancellation_and_retry(self):
+        await self.latest_rejection_and_retry(True)
+
+    async def test_synchronous_callback_failure_and_retry(self):
+        preview, prior = await self.seeded()
+        older = await self.start(preview, object())
+        error, key = RuntimeError("synchronous failure"), object()
+        calls = []
+
+        def fail(actual_key):
+            calls.append(actual_key)
+            self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+            self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+            raise error
+
+        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError) as caught:
+            await asyncio.wait_for(preview.refresh(key, fail), TIMEOUT)
+        self.assertIs(caught.exception, error)
+        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
+        self.assertIs(calls[0], key)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(older[0].done())
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        await self.succeed(*older, object())
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        retry = await self.start(preview, object())
+        self.assertTrue(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, prior)
+        value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*retry, value)
+        self.assertFalse(preview.pending)
+        self.assertIs(preview.value, value)
+
+    async def test_instances_are_independent(self):
+        first, first_prior = await self.seeded()
+        second, second_prior = await self.seeded()
+        older, latest = await self.pair(first, first_prior)
+        other = await self.start(second, object())
+        self.assertTrue(first.pending)
+        self.assertTrue(second.pending)
+        self.assertIs(second.value, second_prior)
+        await self.reject(*latest, False)
+        self.assertFalse(first.pending)
+        self.assertTrue(second.pending)
+        self.assertIs(first.value, first_prior)
+        self.assertIs(second.value, second_prior)
+        second_value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*other, second_value)
+        self.assertFalse(second.pending)
+        self.assertIs(second.value, second_value)
+        retry = await self.start(first, object())
+        await self.succeed(*older, object())
+        self.assertTrue(first.pending)
+        self.assertFalse(second.pending)
+        self.assertIs(second.value, second_value)
+        first_value = object()
+        await self.succeed(*retry, first_value)
+        self.assertFalse(first.pending)
+        self.assertIs(first.value, first_value)
+        self.assertFalse(second.pending)
+        self.assertIs(second.value, second_value)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
*** End Patch"));
